Third-party skill from [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) (Apache-2.0, Anthropic), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. ## Purpose
Read, create, merge, split, fill, or OCR PDF files.

## Use it for
- "read this PDF"
- "fill this PDF form"
- "merge these PDFs"

## Not for
- a Word document (docx)
- a spreadsheet (xlsx)
- slides (pptx)

## Accepted inputs
PDF files, or the content of a PDF to create.

## Deliverables
A PDF, extracted text or fields, or a filled form.
